name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 4px focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast with a subtle 1px inner glow. This balances visibility for low-vision users with subtlety for neurodivergent users who dislike flicker. The thicker ring ensures keyboard navigators see clear targets on mobile and touch devices. Trade-off: the glow adds slight motion, but it’s minimal and respects reduced-motion preferences.

name: Reader
text: The 4px ring with glow still risks failing users who need high contrast—glow can blur edges on mobile screens, making the ring harder to spot. A 6px ring at 7:1 contrast without glow meets WCAG AAA and works under fingers. Test both on actual devices with screen readers and keyboard-only users to settle it.
